a.lede: NVIDIA's board chair said it doesn't want Jensen Huang back in the CEO role during the company's first earnings call since his resignation.
a.title: NVIDIA's board chair says the company is not considering reinstating Jensen Huang as CEO

b.lede: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman acknowledged the special role Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has played in the AI boom, but ultimately thinks the industry will be “fine” without him at the helm.
b.title: Sam Altman on Nvidia without Jensen Huang: the industry will be ‘fine’
